北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风大天冷，体感仅 -4℃，记得穿暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is windy and cold, feels like -4℃. Remember to bundle up!
北京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有霾，体感 10℃。外出请注意防护，保护呼吸道！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is hazy and feels like 10℃. Wear a mask when out and about!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海扬沙，体感 8℃。注意防沙防风，保护皮肤和眼睛。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has blowing dust, feels like 8℃. Protect your skin and eyes, stay safe!
上海.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州暖暖的 25℃，晴好天气，尽情享受吧！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is lovely and warm at 25℃. Enjoy the beautiful day!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳 23℃，多云舒适。别忘了多喝水，保持好心情！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and comfortable at 23℃. Stay hydrated and happy!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴好，体感 13℃。风力较大，出门注意保暖防风。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny, feels like 13℃. It's windy, so dress warmly and beware of the wind.
杭州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京扬沙，体感 12℃。出门记得戴口罩，保护好自己。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has blowing dust, feels like 12℃. Wear a mask when going out, stay safe!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云 20℃，体感舒适。注意添减衣物，保持健康！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and comfortable at 20℃. Adjust your clothing to stay well!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云 21℃，体感 18℃。风力稍大，出行注意保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy at 21℃, feels like 18℃. It's a bit windy, so dress warmly when out.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安天阴，体感 10℃，湿度很低。记得多喝水，注意保湿！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like 10℃, with very low humidity. Drink more water and moisturize!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云 22℃，体感宜人。享受美好时光，别忘了微笑！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and pleasant at 22℃. Enjoy the good times and don't forget to smile!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -13℃，非常冷！务必穿最厚的衣服，注意防寒。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -13℃, extremely cold! Bundle up warmly and stay safe from the cold.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳风大天晴，体感 -10℃。注意防风保暖，谨防感冒。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and windy, feels like -10℃. Stay warm and avoid colds!
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃ | 💨 北风警报：西北风 4级

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云 20℃，体感 16℃。早晚温差大，记得添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy at 20℃, feels like 16℃. Big temperature difference, dress in layers.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云 21℃，湿度较高。出行请带伞，保持好心情。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and 21℃, with high humidity. Bring an umbrella and stay happy!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴朗，体感 2℃。气温偏低，多穿几件，注意保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny, feels like 2℃. It's chilly, wear extra layers to stay warm!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗，体感 -3℃。寒意十足，记得多加衣物。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny, feels like -3℃. It's quite cold, so remember to wear more layers.
